docs.text: CV - Tomáš Hák Senior Test Automation Engineer I am an experienced automation developer with great analytical and technical skills. I have knowledge of the whole testing process and methodology, especially automation and performance testing, backed up with broad programming skills. I have experience with leading of small teams in agile environment. I am highly responsible and reliable. I am a lector of GIT&Jenkins, RobotFramework and Performance testing courses. I have prepared webinars about RF, CI and other. Language English – Intermediate Czech - Native Computer Software Skills programming skills - Python, PHP, Java, VBScript, Groovy, Javascript, Blueprint (APIARY), Swagger SQL, Rest + Soap API, SoapUI, HP UFT, Robot Framework, Insomnia, Postman, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Reportportal, Docker, Linux (Putty SSH), Citrix, Github Actions, Jenkins, TFS, Jira, HP ALM, Openshift GIT, jMeter, K6, Locust.io, Selenium, TestComplete. Trainings & Certificationss ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level: 04/2017 ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level Technical Test Analyst: 09/2017 Robot Framework Certified Profesional, RFCP: 05/2025 Education 2006-2008, Ing., Faculty of electronics and communication technology, Brno university of technology, Master’s degree Work experience Tesena,s.r.o (from 052017) as QA Automation Lead I act as a lecturer (trainer) for all-day courses: - Test automation with Robot Framework (beginners and advanced) - DevOps (Git + Jenkins) - Performance testing (JMeter) Project(s): Digiteq Automotive (02/2024-) Role: Test Automation Architect Responsibilities: - Preparing environment for automation tests for embedded and network devices. - Creating and parsing input data for scripts. - Technical consultation about tools for automation. - Support for Robot Framework and Python´s issues Internal projects in Tesena (from 2017) Tasks: - Creating webinars on Youtube about technical topics - Writing articles - Support and maintenance for our virtual testing server (Ubuntu) - Creating Bootcamps (online technical courses for juniors in our team) - Preparing online public courses (DevOps, Robot Framework, Integration testing, Performance testing, DB) - Cooperation on Tesena Podcast Recording. - Mentoring for our trainers. - I lead interviews for technical candidates. - Preparation of the technical part of the offer cooperation on various projects. Česká národní banka (09/2023-) Role: Senior Test Automation Specialist Responsibilities: - Prepare PoC of Automation tests for Windows application in Robot Framework - Installation TestRail tool, Jenkins and virtual server (Windows Server 2019) - Consultation and preparation lectures for internals Porsche Engineering Services, s.r.o (02/2023-01/2024) Role: Senior Test Automation Specialist Responsibilities: - Maintenance of automation tests (Robot framework) for concrete area of systems for electric cars (thermo management for batteries). Release every week. - Preparing to integrate test results and tools for the Test Management (Code Beamer) - Help with best practices for writing scripts of automation tests (tools, clean code). - CI/CD pipelines (gitlab, Jenkins) - Cooperate with developers from Germany. - All meetings were in English Elanor, s.r.o - www.elanor.cz (01-02/2023) Role: Technical consultant Responsibilities: - A proposal and preparation of complete test framework for automation tests. - Focus on automation of Rest API (JSON data) and Web APP. (international HR system) - Scripting POC (3 TC, processing of complex JSON, using JSON path) - Preparation of pipeline in Jenkins, use virtual PC with Ubuntu. - Run tests in Docker container. - Writing documentation and customer’s team training - Submission and presentation of results Kistler company – SK branch in Bratislava (11/2021-12/2022) Role: Senior Test Automation Specialist Responsibilities: - Defined overall strategy and approach for test automation within Kistler – team Comoneo (embedded systems). - Conducted test analysis and manual testing of new features using a browser inside a Docker container. - Wrote and maintained over 1200 automation tests in Robot Framework, running nightly in Docker. - Worked in a Linux environment, maintaining shell scripts for running tests and building pipelines in Jenkins. - Prepared plans for automation testing on real devices, including RF tests for GUI applications and managing real I/O generators to simulate digital/analog signals. - Coordinated testing with other teams and prepared Virtual Machines for deploying applications in defined versions (Git branches). ŠKODA AUTO a.s., Test Automation of internal systems (2021) Role: Test Consultant Responsibilities: - Defined overall strategy and approach for test automation within ŠKODA AUTO – internal database system. - Conducted test analysis and manual testing of MapR DB (SQL) and Rest API for internal backend (UVD). - Reported to stakeholders. - Prepared automation scripts in Robot Framework and Python, executed in TFS (GIT + CI). - Collaborated with other teams during production testing of new features. Tools: - Robot Framework, Python, Postman, Citrix, Putty+WinSCP (SSH), Apache Drill, Mapr DBshell, TFS, Jira, Openshift, APIM, Swagger Česká spořitelna a.s., Test Automation Strategy (2017-2018) Role: Test Consultant Responsibilities: - Definition of overall strategy and approach for test automation within Česká spořitelna - focus on core system (Starbank) - Coordination of test automation - Reporting to stakeholders Tools: - HP ALM, JIRA Česká spořitelna a.s., Projects PremiumAPI, PaymentButton 360, PSD2, Open banking (2018-2021) Role: Senior Test Automation Engineer Responsibilities: - Preparing framework for running automation tests (RobotFramework + SoapUI) - Maintenance and error checking in CI/CD and in GIT - Manual testing with Insomnia - Preparing test data (CSV, DB) - Testing connection of other banks into aggregation API - Supporting dev team Tools: - Oracle DB, Putty SSH (Linux Debian), APIARY, Jenkins, Jira, Python, Groovy, Elasticsearch + Kibana, IntelliIDEA, PyCharm Česká spořitelna a.s., Implementation of automation tests – various projects (2017) Role: Senior Test Automation Engineer Responsibilities: - Covering 3 types of applications. - Preparing Git repository, Jenkins server, and virtual PC with tools. - Training internal team for this framework. - Cooperating with internal team CSAS. - Using Robot Framework, HP UFT (Visual Basic), SoapUI, and sometimes bash. Tools: - WSDL, Jenkins, HP ALM, Jira, Groovy. Česká spořitelna a.s., Implementation automation tests for project Colos (2018) Role: Senior Test Automation Engineer Responsibilities: - Preparing Git repository, Jenkins jobs, and virtual PC with tools. - Implementation PoC. - Support for team members. - Using RobotFramework and Selenium. Tools: - Jenkins, Jira, Python, Groovy. Manor.is, Automation tests for CRM system (2019) Role: Senior Test automatization engineer Responsibilities: - Preparing Git repository, Jenkins jobs and virtual PC with tools - Management of small team of testers - Reporting to customer - Code reviews in GIT - Implementation in Robot Framework Tools: - GIT and Jenkins - Robot Framework 11/2015 – 04/2017: Senior Test Automation Engineer E-commerce Holding, a.s. Responsibilities: Setting up testing process in agile environment Test environment preparation (specialized tools for TC administration, automation, documentation, etc.) Communication with stakeholders, product owners Responsibility for release testing, preparation of test plan Building up a testing team, training and workshops Test automation (API, SQL), Jenkins tool administration Testing of technology 3MW platform for e-shops (kolonial.cz, bigbrands.cz/sk, prodeti.cz/sk and bux.cz) Replacing Behat framework with Codeception framework 01/2014 - 10/2015: Tester / Programmer Internet Mall, a.s. Responsibilities: Testing process monitoring of web and mobile e-shop application Mall.cz Creating and administrating automated tests (Selenium, Python, PHP) Coordination and leading of small team of testers Communication with developers Implementation of continuous integration (Jenkins) and agile development Helpdesks and incidents in production Application Tester / Developer, Jobs.cz Projects: 05/2009 - 11/2013: LMC s.r.o., Praha 06/2008 - 04/2009: IPS s.r.o., Brno (outsourcing) Responsibilities: Administration of existing automated test for job portals Jobs.cz, Prace.cz a Teamio.com Coordination and training of testing team Implementation of new testing technologies (Squish, Testlink, GIT, Jmeter, Testcomplete, Selenium) Cooperation in testing process setting in agile environment (scrum) Small programming tasks - Java, Python, SQL
